subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SJR30
title: Proposes an amendment to the Oregon Constitution to require petition signatures for initiative laws to contain at least eight percent of the total votes cast for all candidates for Governor at the last general election at which a Governor was elected divided equally among the congressional districts of this state. Proposes an amendment to the Oregon Constitution to require petition signatures for initiative amendments to the Oregon Constitution to contain at least ten percent of the total votes cast for all candidates for Governor at the last general election at which a Governor was elected divided equally among the congressional districts of this state.
headline: SJR 30 did not pass

claims.text: SJR 30 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SJR 30 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 4 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
SJR 30 is a proposed change to the Oregon Constitution. It would have gone to voters if passed; it did not pass, so it will not be on your ballot.

timeline.text: Public hearing held in a Senate committee
